pattern_name: GitLab Pages Auth Redirect (Pages Access Control) Pattern (2026-07)
summary: A GitLab Pages site can deploy successfully yet still 302-redirect to projects.gitlab.io/auth due to Pages access control; diagnose quickly via pages_access_level and redirect fingerprints, and recognize possible namespace-level overrides.

evidence.note: In this environment, following redirects may hit a Cloudflare challenge/403; CI+API evidence is sufficient to prove deployment.

source: Day 456 GitLab Pages migration/debugging (API checks + curl redirect chain)
